conclusions: Accepted staging took 2797 seconds (46m37s) from run creation to completion; Linux functional and Color are the critical path.
Linux job 2459s: engine matrix 2151s and Color 224s; dependency/download steps 47s+17s. Removing cold-install costs alone cannot deliver a 10-minute staging suite.
Windows job 2048s is labeled smoke but executes 40 normal rows plus 8 navigation and 26 analytics with full normal assertions; actual native smoke work 1972s.
macOS full WebKit work is 1023s, performance work 237s Lighthouse plus 525s motion/CPU/soak. Parallel workers preserve cold engine conditions but still wait for Linux.
PRs currently run no full hosted regression by default. Latest complete PR preview is 248s; installed Chromium 33s, actual smoke 61s. Basic local step is 2s; RI job 14s; owning acceptance 19s.
There are repeated source proofs and independent repeated local.cjs calls, but their durations are seconds. The long wait is caused principally by stage invoking the production-sized matrix.
Keep earliest preview publication/comment ahead of slower checks. Whole-run workflow head for owner /stage is protected main controller, not the candidate PR source.

duplication.cost: 2-3 seconds per observed source invocation plus separate jobs setup/artifact uploads
duplication.disposition: Reuse one successful source-bound common manifest or move common smoke into one canonical PR entrypoint. Preserve per-AC mapping to tested results.

duplication.same_work: RI verify and enduring RI/CI/root/test-selector methods are repeated across ordinary PR and owning acceptance and full source suite
duplication.disposition: Keep unconditional current RI freshness, combine or reuse exact-source result where safe; task policy can point to canonical result and targeted methods.

duplication.same_work: Full source step reruns local focused tests via all Node tests and enduring Python tests after immutable build/basic check
duplication.disposition: Retain full source on production path; stage use scoped source modules plus existing basic package proof.

duplication.same_work: Two protected-main trusted staging controllers use different recovery/state mechanisms and both invoke full regression
duplication.cost: not simultaneous today because SITE_STAGING_ENABLED absent/false; a future opt-in could create ambiguity
duplication.disposition: Retire the dormant legacy staging edge or route both through the same explicit tier and state owner; preserve all sourcetrust/promote/rollback protections.

duplication.same_work: site-release-candidate label launches same full suite without host/device-review artifact inputs
duplication.cost: potential full 40+ minute run unable to satisfy external release evidence by default
duplication.disposition: Retire label route in favor of explicit production dispatch with exact candidate and external inputs, or redefine it as clearly non-authorizing full automation only.

hazards.detail: full=false still runs all three Linux engines with all failure cases, emits pr-gate, and cannot satisfy staged hosted-gate mandatory jobs. Do not use this flag as a light staging shortcut.
A new stage gate must carry a distinct kind/profile/check-list and strict report cardinality/source identity. Preview smoke must not authorize staging and stage gate must not authorize production.

Numbered old issue acceptance snapshots are historical exact-source proof, not perpetual regression. Existing run_repository_tests.py already excludes numbered task modules; selected policies remain explicit.
Queue/download latency remains external. State a configured staging wall budget and measured new run separately; these historical timings do not prove a future profile speed.

Issue13 still owns real iPhone/iPad Safari and modest Android evidence, independent production-release review, production origin checks and rollback exercise; tier optimization does not itself meet those external gates.
